requirements.text: a given-in swap between two tokens of the pool goes through, for any well-behaved math, when the scaling factor of the token out is positive and the fee is below 100%.

a given-out swap between two tokens of the pool goes through, for any well-behaved math, when the exact amount out rounded up is below the pool's balance of that token (both in 18-decimal units), the scaling factor of the token in is positive and the fee is below 100%.

in a given-in swap the trader receives at most what the math prices the exact amount in, net of the fee, rounded down: `y * rate_out / 1e18` is at most `outGivenIn` of that amount. Rounding never pays out more than the trader paid for.
and it receives at least what the math prices one raw unit less than the net amount in, less one raw unit out: the rounding costs the trader at most one unit on each side.

in a given-out swap the trader is charged, after the fee, at least what the math prices the exact amount out rounded up to a whole 18-decimal unit: `c * (1 - fee) * rate_in / 1e18` is at least `outPrice`. Rounding never lets the trader take more than it pays for.
requirements.witness: 66982 out charged 249952628 in; the exact amount out, rounded up to 70876 scaled units, prices at 263816223

requirements.text: and one raw unit less than the charge, after the fee, is below that price plus one raw unit of the token in: the rounding costs the trader at most one unit for the conversion back to raw units and one for the fee.
for any well-behaved math, a swap that goes through never lowers the pool's value as the pool measures it (`value`).
requirements.witness: swap of 17 lowered the pool's value from 4750372932 to 2375399004

requirements.text: for any well-behaved math, any pool and any batch of swaps of either kind, a batch that goes through never lowers the pool's value as the pool measures it. The rounding of one swap cannot be repeated inside a batch to drain the pool.
requirements.witness: batch of 12 swaps lowered the pool's value from 4749898000 to 297229191
